description: This file defines a UI component BrowseFragment for an Android TV application, displaying a list of video items using Leanback library components, handling item clicks to start a video player activity.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment extending BrowseSupportFragment that displays a row of video items and handles user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting title, headers, and setting up rows and click listeners.

methods.name: setupRows
methods.description: Sets up the rows adapter with video items fetched from VideoCatalog.

methods.name: setupClickListeners
methods.description: Configures click listener to handle item clicks and launch PlayerActivity with item details.
